title: Extension of a locally nilpotent ideal is locally nilpotent
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to R'$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $I\subseteq R$ an ideal all of whose elements are nilpotent (a locally nilpotent ideal). Then every element of the ideal $IR'$ of $R'$ generated by $\varphi(I)$ is nilpotent.

mathlib_match.how: a few Mathlib lemmas, one per clause: I <= comap phi (nilradical R') because phi x is nilpotent for x in I (IsNilpotent.map, Mathlib/RingTheory/Nilpotent/Defs.lean:34, with mem_nilradical, Mathlib/RingTheory/Nilpotent/Lemmas.lean:51); hence Ideal.map phi I <= nilradical R' (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, Ideal/Maps.lean:76), i.e. every element of IR' is nilpotent (mem_nilradical).
